_doc: INTG-03 consent ledger, checked at build by src/lib/integrity.mjs. Never write a child's name here: `ref` points to the signed form kept outside the repo (paper file or the Google Form response). consents: {id: c-YYYY-NNN, ref, given: YYYY-MM-DD, revoked?: YYYY-MM-DD, scopes: [site, youtube, social, first_name, full_name, results]}. media: {"<path as in npm run review>": {minors: true|false, consents?: [id]}}. Empty until the owner records signed forms; npm run review lists what is still unclassified.

consents.ref: owner confirmed 2026-10-29, names + photos, Maribor post
